preconditions.description: The dimensions of the park must be within the specified bounds.
The total number of cells in the park must not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i][j] <= n * m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All silence levels in the cells must be within the range from 1 to n*m.

postconditions.description: The output must be the number of pleasant segments of silence.
